claim: Trace Press makes free printable CVC word worksheets in the browser: 15 three-letter words (bat to sun), five to a page on three US Letter pages. Each row has a picture to say, three boxes to write the word's letters in, and the word in dots on writing lines to trace, with room after it to write it alone. No sign-up.
notes: Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It pages through the three sheets on the page, downloads the PDF, and ends on pages 1 (bat, cat, map, rat, van) and 3 (bus, cup, mug, nut, sun) of that PDF rendered from the file. The final 2.2 s hold page 3 still for the end card.
